_response.answer: Conflicting authoritative sources detected. DEMO-ATT-A (§1.1) states 80percent while DEMO-ATT-B (§1.1) states 85percent; both have the same authority level and effective date, so the precedence policy cannot resolve this. Please contact the issuing office. Both sources are cited below.

effective 1 November 2026. Other conditions and approval requirements remain applicable.
